findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess
 * @description Using subprocess with untrusted input can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-dateutil
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Subprocess call that may be vulnerable to command injection."
findings.hypothesis: Check for subprocess calls that could be vulnerable to command injection

message.text: Subprocess call that may be vulnerable to command injection.

/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description File operations without proper path validation can lead to path traversal
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal-file-ops
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink", "rmdir", "mkdir", "makedirs"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["rmtree", "copy", "copy2", "copytree", "move"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "File operation that may be vulnerable to path traversal."
findings.hypothesis: Check for file operations that may be vulnerable to path traversal attacks

 */

import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

  (
    call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["mktemp", "TemporaryFile", "NamedTemporaryFile", "mkdtemp", "mkstemp"]).getACall() or
